kashika: कर्मण्युपपदे हन्तेर्धातोर्णिनिः प्रत्ययो भवति भूते काले। पितृव्यघाती। मातुलघाती ॥ कुत्सितग्रहणं कर्तव्यम्॥ इह मा भूत् — चौरं हतवान्॥
kashikaEnglish: णिनि after हन् with accusative upapada, past sense, implying censure: पितृव्यघातिन् 'uncle-killer', मातुलघातिन् 'maternal-uncle-killer'. Not: चोरं हतवान् (no censure for killing thief).
englishFull:
हनः कर्मणि — "After हन् with an accusative उपपद, णिनि is used with past-time meaning."

| Example | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| पितृव्यघाती | one who has killed his paternal uncle |
| मातुलघाती | one who has killed his maternal uncle |

**Derivation:** हन् + णिनि → घन् → घत् → घातिन्

@note[Only when censure is implied. कर्मणि extends to @ref[3.2.96].]
